style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape resource location illustration for a Chinese xianxia RPG card. Create one finished beautiful 16:9 landscape painting.

assets.brief: A tranquil emerald bamboo valley spirit rice terrace, luminous jade rice ears, a clear winding stream, small ancient wooden waterwheel and a tasteful stone cultivation shrine.
A misty wetland medicinal herb garden, turquoise shallow pools with pink lotus flowers, orderly beds of glowing medicinal blossoms, a curved timber boardwalk and small distant traditional pavilion.

An ancient submerged crystal mine at a sea abyss, enormous luminous cobalt and aquamarine crystal clusters growing among weathered Chinese stone arches, soft sunlight shafts through clear blue seawater, tiny fish.
A sacred geothermal spirit pool amid snowy mountains, milky turquoise spring water with curling steam, frosted pines, white jade rocks, a small distant Chinese snow-covered shrine.

A secluded violet twilight mountain ravine herb garden, rare luminous purple and gold medicinal plants in a mossy stone terrace, old gnarled roots and a gentle thin waterfall, serene mysterious atmosphere.

A magnificent floating mountain spirit vein high above an endless golden cloud sea, luminous amber quartz embedded in a floating jade rock island, cascading waterfalls disappearing into clouds, distant elegant Chinese celestial pavilions.

constraints: Polished hand-painted Chinese fantasy game environment, delicate brush texture, richly detailed natural materials, soft atmospheric depth, jewel-like controlled colors, luminous focal point at center. Strongly readable when reduced to a small mobile card. Full bleed scene, no frame, no interface, no lettering, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no characters. Horizontal composition.
